Author:     Kai Engert <kaie@kuix.de>

    Bug 1984403 - Use nsINSSErrorsService.isErrorOverridable. r=mkmelin
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D261976

diff --git a/mail/components/im/content/imAccounts.js b/mail/components/im/content/imAccounts.js
index f7defd035fc..04b6736b9b1 100644
--- a/mail/components/im/content/imAccounts.js
+++ b/mail/components/im/content/imAccounts.js
@@ -221,26 +221,19 @@ var gAccountManager = {
       document.getElementById(account.id).updateConnectingProgress();
     } else if (aTopic == "account-connect-error") {
       document.getElementById(account.id).updateConnectionError();
-      // See NSSErrorsService::ErrorIsOverridable.
+
+      const nssErrorsService = Cc[
+        "@mozilla.org/nss_errors_service;1"
+      ].getService(Ci.nsINSSErrorsService);
       if (
-        [
-          "MOZILLA_PKIX_ERROR_ADDITIONAL_POLICY_CONSTRAINT_FAILED",
-          "MOZILLA_PKIX_ERROR_CA_CERT_USED_AS_END_ENTITY",
-          "MOZILLA_PKIX_ERROR_EMPTY_ISSUER_NAME",
-          "MOZILLA_PKIX_ERROR_INADEQUATE_KEY_SIZE",
-          "MOZILLA_PKIX_ERROR_MITM_DETECTED",
-          "MOZILLA_PKIX_ERROR_NOT_YET_VALID_CERTIFICATE",
-          "MOZILLA_PKIX_ERROR_NOT_YET_VALID_ISSUER_CERTIFICATE",
-          "MOZILLA_PKIX_ERROR_SELF_SIGNED_CERT",
-          "MOZILLA_PKIX_ERROR_V1_CERT_USED_AS_CA",
-          "SEC_ERROR_CA_CERT_INVALID",
-          "SEC_ERROR_CERT_SIGNATURE_ALGORITHM_DISABLED",
-          "SEC_ERROR_EXPIRED_CERTIFICATE",
-          "SEC_ERROR_EXPIRED_ISSUER_CERTIFICATE",
-          "SEC_ERROR_INVALID_TIME",
-          "SEC_ERROR_UNKNOWN_ISSUER",
-          "SSL_ERROR_BAD_CERT_DOMAIN",
-        ].includes(account.prplAccount.securityInfo?.errorCodeString)
+        nssErrorsService.isNSSErrorCode(
+          account.prplAccount.securityInfo?.errorCode
+        ) &&
+        nssErrorsService.isErrorOverridable(
+          nssErrorsService.getXPCOMFromNSSError(
+            account.prplAccount.securityInfo.errorCode
+          )
+        )
       ) {
         this.addException();
       }
diff --git a/mailnews/compose/src/MessageSend.sys.mjs b/mailnews/compose/src/MessageSend.sys.mjs
index 71e2026898c..54bf14ff2a7 100644
--- a/mailnews/compose/src/MessageSend.sys.mjs
+++ b/mailnews/compose/src/MessageSend.sys.mjs
@@ -629,29 +629,7 @@ export class MessageSend {
         if (nssErrorsService.isNSSErrorCode(secInfo.errorCode)) {
           isNSSError = true;
           exitCode = nssErrorsService.getXPCOMFromNSSError(secInfo.errorCode);
-
-          if (
-            [
-              "MOZILLA_PKIX_ERROR_ADDITIONAL_POLICY_CONSTRAINT_FAILED",
-              "MOZILLA_PKIX_ERROR_CA_CERT_USED_AS_END_ENTITY",
-              "MOZILLA_PKIX_ERROR_EMPTY_ISSUER_NAME",
-              "MOZILLA_PKIX_ERROR_INADEQUATE_KEY_SIZE",
-              "MOZILLA_PKIX_ERROR_MITM_DETECTED",
-              "MOZILLA_PKIX_ERROR_NOT_YET_VALID_CERTIFICATE",
-              "MOZILLA_PKIX_ERROR_NOT_YET_VALID_ISSUER_CERTIFICATE",
-              "MOZILLA_PKIX_ERROR_SELF_SIGNED_CERT",
-              "MOZILLA_PKIX_ERROR_V1_CERT_USED_AS_CA",
-              "SEC_ERROR_CA_CERT_INVALID",
-              "SEC_ERROR_CERT_SIGNATURE_ALGORITHM_DISABLED",
-              "SEC_ERROR_EXPIRED_CERTIFICATE",
-              "SEC_ERROR_EXPIRED_ISSUER_CERTIFICATE",
-              "SEC_ERROR_INVALID_TIME",
-              "SEC_ERROR_UNKNOWN_ISSUER",
-              "SSL_ERROR_BAD_CERT_DOMAIN",
-            ].includes(secInfo?.errorCodeString)
-          ) {
-            isOverridable = true;
-          }
+          isOverridable = nssErrorsService.isErrorOverridable(exitCode);
         }
       }
title: Bug 1984403 - Use nsINSSErrorsService.isErrorOverridable. r=mkmelin
